author: GustavWalsted
seen: Primal Queen's live offer page behind the Meta ad. The headline is "BUY ONE GET ONE FREE". How it works: 1) buy any 2 Primal Queen products at your nearest Target; 2) enter your phone number; 3) we text you a link to upload your receipt; 4) once verified we refund via PayPal or Venmo. "That's it. One product is on us." Under that is a "FIND MY CLOSEST target" store locator with a map. Paid social drives retail sell-through, and the brand captures the SMS list.
